The retrieved docs cover most of this, but not the full embedding setup, so part of the code below is from general knowledge and I've marked it.

**Local LLM (from the docs):** The docs show Ollama configured like this, with the prerequisite that "if you have [Ollama] installed and running" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md]. The import is "from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md]. The LLM package is `llama-index-llms-ollama` [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms/local.md].

**Global embedding setting (pattern from the docs):** The docs set the global default through `Settings`: "# changing the global default" followed by "Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. You replace the OpenAI model with a local one.

**Local embedding model:** The docs name `HuggingFaceEmbedding` as the local option, which "runs any Sentence Transformers model on your own hardware" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/privacy.md]. The retrieved context doesn't include its import path or constructor, so the import and `model_name` below are from my general knowledge. Check them against the embeddings guide.

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbedding  # not in retrieved docs

# Global LLM: local Ollama server
Settings.llm = Ollama(
    model="llama3.3",
    request_timeout=60.0,
    context_window=8000,
)

# Global embedding model: runs locally via Sentence Transformers
Settings.embed_model = HuggingFaceEmbedding(
    model_name="BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5",  # example model, not from the docs
)
```

Set these before you build any index or query engine, so every component picks up the global values.

**Ensuring OpenAI is never contacted:** The docs don't explicitly say what LlamaIndex uses when nothing is set, so don't rely on that. Setting both `Settings.llm` and `Settings.embed_model` as above covers the two places the docs show OpenAI being used. If you also use a reranker, the docs describe `SentenceTransformerRerank` as "a cross-encoder that runs locally, no API key required" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/privacy.md].
